value_authority: Concrete source profile. Skeleton nested examples never override its real fields, defaults or dependencies.

requirements: The target must be a scalar derived field with exactly one writer.
The local source byte length must be divisible by unit; result=(bytes/unit)*multiply+add.
This real MBAP rule uses add=-6; it does not add a checksum or new service to Modbus.
This ENIP path_words field counts 2-byte words in its epath source.
count_of counts encoded source bytes divided by unit, not arbitrary semantic array elements.
unit and multiply default to 1; add defaults to 0; any result must fit the target range.
No checked-in industrial profile declares this rule; this excerpt is not a runnable protocol package.
Replace the illustrative locator and target/source declarations only within a real codec-supported message that actually defines this rule.
Structural sources must be local; the target must be scalar derived with one writer.
offset_of computes the located source byte offset plus add; unit=multiply=1.
It does not reorder bytes or add a pointer encoding not implemented by the codec.
No checked-in industrial profile declares this rule; this excerpt is not a runnable protocol package.
Replace the illustrative locator and target/source declarations only within a real codec-supported message that actually defines this rule.
Structural sources must be local; the target must be scalar derived with one writer.
Supported algorithms are sum8 and crc32; no algorithm is inferred from protocol name.
If target lies entirely inside source, its bytes are zeroed before calculation; the result must fit target width/range.
This does not claim Modbus TCP or any other checked-in profile carries this checksum.
Target and source must be compatible scalar types and widths.
The named source message and field must exist; current engine/message/field cache stores latest value.
scope is an annotation and does not allocate a transaction database.
The source message must be a response model with a compatible scalar.
The actual response must arrive and validate in the live session; a fixture cannot invent a session value.
An unresolved binding rejects preparation; send state commits only after complete submission.
The target belongs to a response and the source to a request.
The check compares compatible actual scalar values; it does not rewrite an observed response.
The executor allows one outstanding response-bearing request.
Sequence generation uses this target own previous value; source must be $message or the target itself.
The OPC UA codec has its bounded shared UA sequence treatment; other targets use their own cached scalar.
Non-UA targets increment their cached target by unit. The scoped UA shared sequence path advances by one; retain unit=1 for that path. multiply=1 and add=0 are required.
Describes static structure only; operation is excluded from RUNTIME_OPS.
This rule does not make a generic conditional decoder or evaluate an expression.
Only the MMS ber:presentation variable ber_tlv target with local $message source is accepted online.
The codec re-encodes its scoped BER/presentation lengths; this is not a general ASN.1 compiler.

limitations: This catalog does not generate or extend a codec.
scope/when annotations do not execute conditions or allocate scoped caches.
Static structure_model and state guard/actions are not scripts.
Session caches reset each execution/connection; one pending response-bearing request.
Examples, schema acceptance and compilation do not prove a real target session or comparative method effectiveness.

strategy_contract.head_scalar: enum/boundary/bitflip/arithmetic are executable; values is an enum candidate pool, not a closed parser domain
strategy_contract.content_scalar: AFL projection; values and scalar strategies do not choose CONTENT scalar values
strategy_contract.content_codec_variable_leaf: resize flag may choose a bounded replacement width, then the codec repairs and validates
strategy_contract.bacnet_who_is_variable_content: the scoped codec selects legal empty or 8-byte limits; no arbitrary strategy script is evaluated
